items.prompt: Only L events add bid 1005 qty 1 and ask 1000 qty 1. What does this REST-ONLY event model do?

options.text: Execute an immediate crossing trade at 10.00.
options.why: This synthetic task executes only M events, unlike ordinary marketable-limit semantics.

options.text: Reject the second L because every crossed quote is invalid.
options.why: The rest-only task permits L orders to rest even when crossed.

options.text: Rest both orders with no trade lines.
options.why: A crossing L does not trigger an automatic matching pass in this declared model.

options.text: Discard both orders and print an empty book.
options.why: No such cross-side cancellation policy exists.

items.explanation: A crossing L does not trigger an automatic matching pass in this declared model.
